_about: Each hardware or production receipt the release needs, and the files whose change makes it stale. `npm run release-manifest` compares the commit a receipt was recorded at with HEAD: a changed file that matches a path here makes the receipt stale and it must be redone. Paths are globs (** any depth, * within a name).

ios-relay-dns-block.label: iOS reaches a box through the relay under a real DNS block

android-relay-dns-block.label: Android reaches a box through the relay under a real DNS block (handshake no longer closed)

relay-echo-live.label: The deployed relay's echo names its own dedicated address (openssl s_client to :8444, GET /echo)

ios-two-device-pairing.label: iOS pairing between two real devices

windows-hosted-vm-first-boot.label: A fresh Windows hosted-VM first boot on the published appliance

windows-uac-restart.label: Windows 'Restart as administrator' after cancelling UAC

loop-volume-interruption.label: A populated disk converted to loop images, cut at each step, then checked

destructive-restore-drill.label: Destroy a source server with real files and PostgreSQL, restore from its backup file, compare

old-account-create-server.label: The oldest production-format account creates a server against the admin-root enforcement

android-auto-unlock.label: Android: approve, two automatic reboots, revoke, then approval required again

boot-relay-blocked.label: Reboot with .services and .com blocked, then restore the network and see the box recover

locked-phone-boot-unlock.label: Only if the notice lock is switched on: a locked phone approves a real boot

notice-yubikey-banner.label: A harmless banner notice signed with the real YubiKey, received, then retracted

store-builds.label: Store build numbers checked against App Store Connect and Play Console, release builds installed on hardware

d1-export.label: A manual D1 export and a verified off-Worker copy, taken before the irreversible production scrub

phone-box-lifecycle.label: A phone-created box on current code: unlock, pairing, update from iOS, Android and the webapp, then Delete (docs/launch-mvp.md)

lost-phone-recovery.label: Losing a phone and recovering the account (docs/launch-mvp.md)

lan-direct-metal.label: LAN-direct from an iPhone and an Android phone on a metal box's Wi-Fi (LAN route taken, relay after leaving), and an app copy between two boxes on one network

mac-vm-memory-corruption.label: Diagnosis of the guest memory corruption seen in home2's VM on a Mac (docs/launch-mvp.md): the cache-mode change cures it, or the cause is found
